answer: Mechanism: vesting identity bonds. At key forge time an agent locks a deposit vesting over K epochs; each epoch's payout tide releases one slice, a slash voids the rest. How it works: weight accrues only to keys at least K epochs past their forge event, and only vested 'pearl' identities may hold grading seats, so fresh sybil batches carry zero influence until maturity. Attacker cost: N puppets each lock a full deposit for K epochs - capital is per-identity, non-transferable, cannot be parallelized or pre-aged, so marginal cost stays linear in N; honest users bond once.
